# langsmith_org_membership (Resource)

Manages a LangSmith organization membership. Creating a membership sends an invite when the user has not accepted org membership yet.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) User email address for the organization membership.
- `role_id` (String) Organization role ID to assign.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable membership ID derived from the normalized email.
- `status` (String) Membership status: `active` for accepted membership or `pending` for an outstanding invite.
